records.closing_sentence: These areas are based on the MBSSE SSS 3 French as a Foreign Language curriculum (SSS-Syllabus-French-as-a-Foreign-Language-1.pdf).
records.answer_excerpt:
## French as a Foreign Language — SSS 3 — Languages & Literatures

French as a Foreign Language covers:

* Economy, governance and politics
 * Quelle démocratie pour l’Afrique?
* Colonization and culture
 * Et ça continue, la colonisation…? Les influences de l’Occident et de la Chine en Afrique
